data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Persian word 'shar', meaning 'noble' and 'faraz', meaning 'king'. This name signifies a noble king or a kingly nobleman. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Sharfaraz usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
